---
title: "Open Analytical Sandbox"
subtitle: "A self-contained workspace for testing, inspecting, and translating AI-generated R"
engine: knitr
---

This lab starts with three small synthetic tables so you can practice joins, summaries, filters, and plots without importing an external file. Use it as a safe place to paste code from an AI assistant. Before you ask for a solution, write down the expected row grain and one result you can calculate by hand.

The tables are:

- `customers`: one row per customer;
- `products`: one row per product;
- `transactions`: one row per transaction.

The live application joins the tables and reports revenue by product category. Your tasks are to add a date filter, calculate average order value, compare repeat and new customers, and write a three-sentence stakeholder summary.

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| components: [editor, viewer]

library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

customers <- data.frame(
  customer_id = paste0("C", 101:108),
  segment = c("Starter", "Starter", "Growth", "Growth", "Enterprise", "Enterprise", "Starter", "Growth"),
  region = c("North", "West", "North", "South", "East", "West", "South", "East")
)

products <- data.frame(
  product_id = paste0("P", 1:6),
  product_name = c("Core Plan", "Analytics Add-on", "Team Seats", "Training", "Integration", "Premium Support"),
  category = c("Subscription", "Subscription", "Subscription", "Service", "Service", "Service"),
  list_price = c(80, 35, 25, 300, 450, 120)
)

transactions <- data.frame(
  transaction_id = paste0("T", 1:16),
  customer_id = c("C101", "C101", "C102", "C103", "C103", "C104", "C105", "C105", "C106", "C107", "C107", "C108", "C102", "C104", "C106", "C108"),
  product_id = c("P1", "P2", "P1", "P3", "P4", "P1", "P5", "P6", "P1", "P2", "P4", "P3", "P6", "P2", "P5", "P1"),
  quantity = c(1, 2, 1, 4, 1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 2, 1, 5, 1, 1, 1, 2),
  transaction_value = c(80, 70, 80, 100, 300, 160, 450, 120, 240, 70, 300, 125, 120, 35, 450, 160),
  month = c("Jan", "Jan", "Jan", "Jan", "Feb", "Feb", "Feb", "Feb", "Feb", "Mar", "Mar", "Mar", "Mar", "Mar", "Mar", "Mar")
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Open analytical sandbox"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("category", "Product category", choices = c("All", sort(unique(products$category)))),
      selectInput("month", "Month", choices = c("All", unique(transactions$month))),
      helpText("Modify the code and rerun the app. Keep the tables synthetic.")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      h4("Joined summary"),
      tableOutput("summary"),
      h4("Revenue by category"),
      plotOutput("plot", height = "420px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  joined <- reactive({
    data <- transactions |>
      left_join(customers, by = "customer_id") |>
      left_join(products, by = "product_id")

    if (input$category != "All") data <- data |> filter(category == input$category)
    if (input$month != "All") data <- data |> filter(month == input$month)
    data
  })

  output$summary <- renderTable({
    joined() |>
      group_by(category) |>
      summarize(
        transactions = n(),
        customers = n_distinct(customer_id),
        units = sum(quantity),
        revenue = sum(transaction_value),
        average_transaction = mean(transaction_value),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    joined() |>
      group_by(category) |>
      summarize(revenue = sum(transaction_value), .groups = "drop") |>
      ggplot(aes(x = reorder(category, revenue), y = revenue)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#176B87") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Revenue", title = "Revenue by product category") +
      coord_flip() +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
